question: By what sovereign titles is Vāsudeva identified in this vision of the deity?
premises: The deity is called lord of all.
He is identified as Vāsudeva and Viṣṇu.
He is the lord and consort of Lakṣmī.
inference: The vision presents Vāsudeva as the all-ruling Viṣṇu and lord of Lakṣmī.
plain_english: He saw Vāsudeva, Viṣṇu, the lord of all, the lord of Lakṣmī, the sovereign master.
